intro: Athridas Bearmantle is a night elf druid residing in Dolanaar within the boughs of Teldrassil. Tasked with safeguarding the local settlement, he directs young adventurers to investigate the encroaching corruption affecting the local wildlife and the nearby Gnarlpine furbolgs.

p: Stationed within Dolanaar, Athridas Bearmantle stands as an early line of defense for the night elves emerging from Shadowglen. As the boughs of the newly grown world tree Teldrassil exhibit unnatural signs of decay and unrest, Athridas works tirelessly to coordinate local scouting efforts and protect the peaceful township from surrounding threats.

Much of Athridas's concern centers on the neighboring Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs. Once peaceful neighbors, the Gnarlpine have succumbed to a spreading madness and corruption that poisons their shamans and chieftains, driving them into violent frenzy against the Kaldorei. Athridas mobilizes willing champions to contain the threat and unearth the deeper taint taking root in the wilderness.
